criteria: Core domains are searched every week; peripheral topics only for high-signal papers. Methods papers are kept only where they intersect a domain, except behavioral data collection and computational modeling methods, which are tracked in their own right. Priority goes to high-impact work, reviews, and papers that apply across several domains. The scope is meant to broaden over time, using the papers dropped into the Inbox folder.
